note: Turn times are the search alone on three exam boards (E10, the defence to act; E13 and E22, the offence to act), taken while other jobs shared the machine. One step further is 4 to 30 times slower, so every level stays at one turn ahead for now. The levels differ in how many turns they keep at each step (8, 16, 24), their pick noise, their variety and what they pay attention to, not in how far ahead they look. The setups don't use the look-ahead: they read the possession's value, which already counts every phase left.
